Author: Solona
Name: Proteus
Description:
• Lets you use overlays — skin-tight gear, tattoos, scales and the like — as a regular Penumbra mod you can toggle on and off, recolour, bind to Glamourer designs and collections, and more.

• Overlays render two ways. Painted into your skin, except now your overlays are dyeable. Or as a second skin, which lets you use sphere maps, metalness and animated glow that skin materials can't do.

• Reshape any mod's models. Paint on your character to pull clothing clear of your body, push it in, smooth it, stretch it across a hollow, or paint where the wind sways it. Hair works too. Edits save into the mod and can be undone.

• Add on/off switches to any part of any mod.

• Make modded hair fit under hats, and undo it any time.

• Import regular old mods and equip them without using a gear slot.

• Save a mod's look as a preset you can wear, share and swap.

• Imports Penumbra .pmp, Onion .omp and Atramentum Luminis .ttmp2 glow tattoos, with no shader mod needed.

• Cloth overlays can enable skindenting with one click.

Type /proteus to manage your Proteus mods.
Punchline: Overlays, off-slot gear and model editing for Penumbra mods
Changelog:
Men's shoes and gloves everywhere, a body per part, NIRÆ sizes, bodysuits over the hands, and toe caps on any mod

Body size (every size)
- Women's shoes and gloves get men's versions from the Studio and the command line too, not only the size set.
- Women's legs and shoes made on a nude body get men's TBSE-X versions as well as TBSE.
- A women's glove made men's draws the men's own arm and hand at the wrist.
- When none of the author's men's model files can be read as a model, the women's piece is made men's instead
  of being left out.
- A TexTools copy of an older game model is no longer mistaken for the author's men's piece.
- The Body size tool remembers a body for each part, and the sizes you picked for each body.

Refit
- A one-piece outfit's legs can go onto a different body than its chest.
- "Made for body" takes down a refit that is showing.
- A body mod that switches its shapes with options (NIRÆ) decides which body the refit is fitted to, and is
  never mistaken for the garment's source.
- NIRÆ's chest offers every build with every chest size, instead of its hip sizes, and its Squish options no
  longer show up as extra builds.
- In the Studio, a leg piece is never offered the chest's sizes.

Bodysuits
- A bodysuit or glove over the hands no longer leaves a hole where a nail sat in the finger (Rue+, YAB+,
  LavaBod+ and others). The nail comes off and the gap is closed, or the nail is kept where that can't be done.
- Long nails (Stabbies, LavaBod+, Tight&Firm) come off under a bodysuit instead of being copied into it.
- Nail styles your body hides are left alone.
- Bodysuits on NIRÆ cover only the chest it draws.
- "Cap the toes" in the Colors window's Geometry section works on every mod. A mod with its own Toe Cap option
  switches that option. Any other mod gets a built-in cap (Bibo+, Neolithe, Rue and YAB).

Imports
- An imported pack's toggle groups only hide and show pieces in their own slot (ring piercings no longer vanish
  with a top).

Please say if anything looks wrong.

Author: Solona
Name: Camera Tools
Description:
• Presents FFXIV's camera to ReShade as an IGCS camera tool, which is what accumulation depth-of-field add-ons need in order to work. Nothing has ever provided one for FFXIV before.

• Works with iMMERSE Parallax DoF and Otis_Inf's IGCS Depth of Field, and with their panorama and multishot capture.

• Frame the shot however you already do — Group Pose, Cammy, Brio. The camera is only taken over while an add-on is stacking frames, and handed straight back afterwards, so this does not compete with anything else you use.

• Requires ReShade 6.4+ with add-on support, plus a compatible depth-of-field add-on.

Type /camtools to see whether an add-on is connected.
Punchline: Lets ReShade's accumulation depth-of-field add-ons drive the GPose camera.
